name: autonomy_policy_evaluate
why: A shared deterministic evaluator is needed so relay, Mac, browser, and pendant make the same ACT/PREPARE/QUEUE/ASK decision without asking the expensive model on every job. It must be fail-closed and expose matched rules for owner-facing explanations.
status: Granted as a schema and not resolvable to anything real (unresolved). Calling it returns that verdict and the nearest real capabilities, not an action.
note: If this tool takes an enum, each value resolves separately — one branch can be live while another is not.
